g.text: (b) Survey power: area × field of view
*Chandra: outer diameter of nested grazing-incidence mirrors. HWO: ~6 m concept, 2040s. Étendue uses geometric aperture area (JWST 25.4 m²) and the field of the main survey camera(s).
